Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS: 12487-1988 



Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
OFFAL HANDLING TABLE FOR SMALL ANIMALS 



(Reaffirmed 2000) 



en 



1. Scope — Specifies material, dimensions, constructioncl and other requirements of offal handling 
table for small animals. 

2. Material — Frame shall be made of mild steel angles conforming to IS : 808 ( Part 5 )-1976 
'Dimensions for hot rolled steel sections : Part 5 Equal leg ^v\q\es { second revision )', ^ndlox 
medium grade galvanized iron pipe Conforming to IS : 1239 ( Part 1 )-1979 ^Mild steel lubes, 
tubular and other wrought steel fittings; Part 1 Mild steel tubes { fourth revision)' . The 
table top and the sink shall be of 2 mm thick stainless steel sheet conforming to the grade 
X04Cr19Ni9 of IS : 1570 ( Part 5 )-1985 'Schedules for wrought steels: Pari 5 Stainless and 
heat resisting steels ( second revision )'. 

3- Dimensions — Shall be as shown in Fig. 1 .

IS: 12487- 1988 

3.1 The tolerances for various dimensions shall be according to IS: 2102 (Part 1 )-1980 
General tolerances for dimensions and form and position : Part 1 General tolerances for linear 
and angular dimensions ( second revision )'. 

4. Constructional Requirements 

4.1 A sink shall be provided, preferably at the left hand side from the centre, as indicated in 
Fig. 1 . The size of the sink shall be 300 x 300 x 225 mm. 

4.1.1 The sink shall be provided with a drain of minimum 40 mm diameter suitable for a 
flexible hose connection. 

4.2 The edges of the taible shall be curved as shown in Fig. 1. 

5. Workmanship and Finish 

5.1 The table shall be smooth, clean, duly polished and free from all defects. 

5.2 The frame shall be enamelled in white. 

6. Marking 

6.1 Each table shall be marked with the following information: 

a) Manufacturer's name or trade-mark, if any; 

b) Year of manufacture; and 

c) Batch or code number. 

6.2 Certification l\/larking — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 

7. Sampling — As agreed to between the manufacturer and the purchaser. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

Offal handling tables are used for stacking the material for cleansing, washing, etc, in 
slaughter houses. 



Reprography Unit, BIS, New Delhi, India
